name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a **3px solid focus ring, outset 1px**, with a **4.5:1 contrast ratio** against the background.

This ensures keyboard users see clear focus without shrinking touch targets or cluttering small elements. The 4.5:1 ratio meets WCAG AA for all text sizes, balancing visibility and subtlety. Trade-off: the ring adds 2px to element dimensions, but the benefit for keyboard navigation outweighs the minimal space cost.

name: Reader
text: A 3px outset ring pushes interactive elements dangerously close to adjacent controls on mobile/touch, risking accidental taps. A 2px inset ring with 4.5:1 contrast avoids this but may vanish on high-DPI screens. Test both on a crowded mobile form at 125% zoom—if either fails WCAG 2.2 touch target spacing, adopt a 2.5px outset ring with 5px gap.
